description: Joint Entrance Examination Main - National level engineering entrance exam

question_types.description: Multiple choice questions with single correct answer

single_correct_mcq.description: Standard MCQ marking with negative marking

numerical.description: No negative marking for numerical questions

sections.name: Section A - Physics
sections.subject: Physics
sections.instructions: This section contains 60 Physics questions. Approximately 42 questions are Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each, having single correct answer. Each correct answer carries 4 marks and each incorrect answer carries -1 mark. Approximately 18 questions are Numerical Answer Type questions where the answer is an integer value (0-9999). Each correct answer carries 4 marks with no negative marking.

sections.name: Section B - Chemistry
sections.subject: Chemistry
sections.instructions: This section contains 60 Chemistry questions. Approximately 42 questions are Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each, having single correct answer. Each correct answer carries 4 marks and each incorrect answer carries -1 mark. Approximately 18 questions are Numerical Answer Type questions where the answer is an integer value (0-9999). Each correct answer carries 4 marks with no negative marking.

sections.name: Section C - Mathematics
sections.subject: Mathematics
sections.instructions: This section contains 80 Mathematics questions. Approximately 56 questions are Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each, having single correct answer. Each correct answer carries 4 marks and each incorrect answer carries -1 mark. Approximately 24 questions are Numerical Answer Type questions where the answer is an integer value (0-9999). Each correct answer carries 4 marks with no negative marking.

general_instructions: Total duration of the examination is 180 minutes (3 hours)
The test consists of 200 questions divided into three sections
Each section must be attempted in the given order
Use of calculator is not permitted
Rough work should be done on the space provided in the test booklet
There is no overall choice. However, internal choices are provided in some questions
Candidates are advised to attempt all questions
